#!/bin/sh
CONFIG_FILE=${CONFIG_FILE:-"/etc/comfyui/plugins.txt"}

if [ ! -f "$CONFIG_FILE" ]; then
  echo "Error: Configuration file not found at $CONFIG_FILE"
  exit 1
fi

while read -r repo dest; do
    # Skip empty lines or lines starting with '#'
    case "$repo" in
        ""|\#*) continue ;;
    esac

    echo "Processing: $repo -> $dest"

    if [ -d "$dest/.git" ]; then
        echo "Updating existing repository at $dest..."
        cd "$dest" || continue
        git fetch --all
        git reset --hard origin/HEAD
        git clean -fd
        cd - > /dev/null
    else
        echo "Cloning new repository into $dest..."
        mkdir -p "$dest"
        git clone "$repo" "$dest"
    fi
done < "$CONFIG_FILE"

set -euo pipefail

if [ ! -s /models/qwen3.5-4b/Qwen3.5-4B-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf ]; then
  pip install --no-cache-dir "huggingface_hub[hf_transfer]"
  mkdir -p /models/qwen3.5-4b
  rm -rf /models/qwen3.5-4b/.cache/huggingface/download/Qwen3.5-4B-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf.lock
  hf download \
    unsloth/Qwen3.5-4B-MTP-GGUF \
    Qwen3.5-4B-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf \
    --local-dir /models/qwen3.5-4b

  echo "Qwen3.5-4B download complete"
else
  echo "Qwen3.5-4B already downloaded, skipping"
fi
